title: Understanding Bias and Variance
text: When you average predictions from multiple models, think about how each model's errors might cancel each other out. Consider how this affects the overall bias and variance of the ensemble model.

title: Effect of Averaging on Variance
text: Averaging predictions from multiple models can reduce variance. This is because the variability in predictions from different models tends to cancel out. How might this impact the overall variance of the ensemble model?

title: Effect of Averaging on Bias
text: Consider how averaging predictions from multiple models affects the bias. If each model has a certain bias, how does combining them influence the overall bias of the ensemble model?
